Added five red-first dispatch tests covering role-level alias, profile-level alias, and freeform pass-through on both paths.

**Finding 2 (high, correctness — doctor ignores project config):** `check_model_catalog()` is now parameterized as `check_model_catalog(project_root=None, *, name_prefix="")`; all role/worker/model/alias resolution uses the given root. It is invoked from `check_registered_project` with `project:<name>:` prefixed check names, so both the `--include-projects` sweep and the explicit `doctor --project` surface (which reuses `check_registered_project`) now probe each project's own roles/profiles/aliases. Tests cover project-config-driven resolution and the presence of all three `project:p1:models:*` checks. This also surfaced and fixed a pre-existing doctor crash: `_validate_roles_against_registry` passed F012 object-shaped `RoleSpec` entries straight into `is_known_agent` (unhashable-type TypeError); it now extracts the name via `role_name()`.
